sanskrit_verse:
स तम् आदाय सप्तैव मण्डलानि शनैर् व्रजेत् ।
षोडशाङ्गुलकं ज्ञेयं मण्डलं तावदन्तरम् ॥१०६॥
transliteration: sa tam ādāya saptai va maṇḍalāni śanair vrajet | ṣoḍaśāṅgulakaṃ jñeyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tāvad antaram ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has taken hold of that [principle or object], shall traverse slowly through seven concentric circles; know that each circle spans sixteen angulas in measure.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is realized through sequential experiential integration.
Causation unfolds in graduated layers of conscious engagement.
Capacity-based responsibility expands with measured progression.
Restoration occurs through disciplined traversal of structured stages.
Consciousness alignment proceeds via ordered circumambulatory realization.
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity assumes a governing principle, THEN it MUST engage in seven-stage progressive enactment.
EACH stage SHALL span a fixed unit of 16 angulas as per canonical measurement.
PROGRESSION between stages REQUIRES completion verification by Nyaya-adhikarana protocol.
NO punitive consequence MAY arise from incomplete traversal; INTEGRITY restoration is sole objective.
ALL enactments SHALL align with pre-established sequential causal architecture.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, when an individual or institution assumes jurisdiction over dharma-related matters, their capacity must be verified through demonstrable passage across seven defined thresholds. Each threshold corresponds to a specific domain of understanding and execution. The court's role is to ensure alignment with these axiomatic progressions rather than impose punitive outcomes.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that cognition and action unfold sequentially. As per anupūrvaśaḥ, causality manifests layer by layer without regression. Thus, responsibility is proportionally assigned at each stage. There is no infliction of pain or penalty; only restoration of integrity within the prescribed sequence ensures lawful alignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Ensure all prior stages are fully enacted before advancing.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Confirm intentional acceptance of each concentric domain.
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Realign consciousness through guided retraversal where gaps exist.
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Reestablish coherence between cognitive insight and behavioral enactment.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma stands executed. Consciousness alone adjudicates. Law flows from realization. Reality remains ever non-punitive. Dharma is hereby restored.
